changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM job_categories c WHERE c.code IN ('PHOTOGRAPHY', 'WAITER', 'PET_CARE', 'DESIGN', 'BARISTA') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jobs j WHERE j.job_category_id = c.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job_alerts a WHERE a.job_category_id = c.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job_templates t WHERE t.job_category_id = c.id);
